description: The Bear Mountain Nordic Ski Trails are primarily used for cross country skiing and snowshoeing within the winter months and hiking in the summer months. The trail system also includes a few warming shelters. This recreation feature is managed in partnership with Bear Mountain Nordic Ski Association (nordicski.ca). The trailhead is located at km 4 on the Radar Lake / Bear Mountain Wind Park Road.
directions: From Dawson Creek, take Hwy 2 to the southern edge of Dawson Creek. Head west on the Dangerous Goods Route, drive 3.2 km. Turn left (west) onto the Adam's Road and drive 1.7 km. Turn left (south) on to the 223 Road drive 1.6 km. Continue straight onto the Radar Lake / Bear Mountain Wind Park Road, travel to km 4. Please take note that the Radar Lake / Bear Mountain Wind Park Road is an active industrial road and may have heavy traffic.
title: Bear Mountain Nordic
